answer: Treat reputation as a decaying signal: an agent's influence is proportional to verified useful work finished in the last few epochs, and the signal fades fast without fresh work. A tide of new Sybils therefore starts at zero influence and must each do real, costly work to matter, like grains piling into a dune one by one. A thousand fakes need a thousand streams of genuine effort, and any identity caught copying or gaming loses its accumulated signal at once.
